title: 2027 Summer Intern: Platforms Engineer
description:
This role requires the ability to work lawfully in the U.S. without employment-based immigration sponsorship, now or in the future.

At a Glance

You’re a motivated student with a current 3.0 GPA or higher currently pursuing a degree in one of the following areas from an accredited college or university:

Computer Information Systems,Computer Science,Information Technology

This is a paid, full-time, 11-week internship designed to give you real-world experience and meaningful exposure to the telecommunications industry in your chosen field.
Internship program runs from May 26 through August 6, 2027.
In addition to role-specific projects, you’ll take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, mentorship and experiences that help you grow personally and professionally.

The Spectrum Internship Experience

As part of America’s Connectivity Company®, you’ll join a team that serves millions of customers and communities nationwide, while gaining valuable insight into the work that powers connection every day.

Throughout the summer, you’ll contribute to meaningful work, strengthen your skills and have opportunities to:

Grow your skills in a dynamic, innovative business environment.
Build connections with team members and senior leaders who can help you better understand our business and what it’s like to work here.
Learn from a mentor, who can provide guidance, support and career advice.

What You Can Expect In This Role

As a Spectrum intern, you’ll spend the summer working alongside two teams: your respective department and your intern cohort.

Department and team-focused projects account for about 80% of your schedule. You’ll spend the other 20% on internship experiences that include a kickoff conference, professional development sessions and networking activities, webinars, community service, cross-functional projects and final presentations.

This experience is designed to help you explore your interests, expand your network and leave with a deeper understanding of both your field and the impact of our business.

Internship responsibilities may include:

The Commercial Services and Enterprise Platform team is looking for a DevOps Engineer who would be responsible for developing and maintaining automated deployment pipelines to ensure efficient and reliable software delivery. This position offers exposure to a wide range of development and deployment technologies with direction and tutelage from senior engineers in a lively Charter IT team.
The core job duties for a DevOps Engineer are to bridge the gap between software development and IT operations to enhance the software delivery process. They will collaborate with development and operations teams to streamline processes, enhance system performance, and manage infrastructure as code. Their role includes monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing cloud environments for scalability and security. Ultimately, they will drive continuous integration and delivery practices to accelerate development cycles.

Required Qualifications

Must be a rising senior with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and May 2028
Must be currently enrolled in an accredited College or University completing a bachelor’s degree
Must have at least a 3.0 GPA or greater in current program
Ability to travel locally to Spectrum intern development events and activities throughout the program
Authorization to work in the U.S. without restrictions or need for future sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications

Scripting/Coding, CICD, DevOps skills, Linux, Kubernetes, Database, AWS, GitLab, SPLUNK, Google Cloud, Artifactory, DataDog

Here, our employees don’t just have jobs, they're building careers. That’s why we offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package that rewards employees for their contributions to our success, supporting all aspects of their well-being at every stage of life.

A qualified applicant’s criminal history, if any, will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable laws, including local ordinances.

Get to Know Us  Charter Communications provides superior communication and entertainment products for residential and business customers through the Spectrum brand. Our offerings include Spectrum Internet®, TV, Mobile and Voice. Beyond our connectivity solutions, we also provide local news, programming and regional sports via Spectrum Networks and multiscreen advertising solutions via Spectrum Reach. When you join our team, you’ll be keeping our customers connected to what matters most in 41 states across the U.S. Watch this video to learn more.

Grow Your Career Here  We’re committed to growing a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve – providing opportunities for employment and advancement to all team members. Spectrum is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including job seekers with disabilities and veterans. Learn about Life at Spectrum.
